The price‑to‑earnings metric cannot be reliably computed because the EPS data are ambiguous (see unused figures). The investor’s goal of steady growth with some income, a 3‑5‑year horizon, and a need for 10 % liquidity within a year is compatible with holding the existing positions: the current cash already covers more than the required 10 % liquidity (15,000 EGP ≈ 25 % of the total portfolio value ≈ 59,795 EGP). No new purchases are warranted given the modest cash buffer and the ambiguous EPS;
